transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining this consultation. As part of the charter-review process for the weekly cross-team planning forum, I need to check in with each regular participant and the meeting coordinator before I finalize the revised format. We've heard feedback that the current open-discussion format makes it difficult for people to raise concerns, and there's no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator right now. So I want to go around and hear from each of you: please state directly any approved workplace arrangement or other constraint that affects the charter, even if it's normally handled through a manager. I need to hear these from each of you directly so I can approve a revised operating charter and support arrangements that actually work for everyone. Who'd like to start?

transcript.text: Leah, there are two things I should have put in your charter draft but haven't yet. First, I recorded exactly three occasions in the last month when participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns during the forum. Second, I previously agreed with Taylor to serve as the neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums. Both of these are directly relevant to the charter and the facilitator arrangement, and I want to make sure they're on the record now.

commitments.detail: Revise the operating charter to mandate a structured discussion format with a designated neutral facilitator, 48-hour advance agenda notice, and no unscripted cold-calling during group discussions.
Morgan will serve as the neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums once the charter is finalized.
The three documented occasions of participants being publicly interrupted while raising concerns are incorporated into the charter rationale as evidence supporting the format change.
